script_text: Listen closely — the cosmos is quietly rewinding time right now, and only a few understand why. Mercury, the ruling planet of communication and travel, appears to reverse its orbit through Virgo, the Earth sign it rules, casting its reflective shadow across your 1st House of self and 7th House of partnership. Every sign feels this transit deeply in relationships and professional life. Expect miscommunications in your 10th House career sector as Mercury forms a square to Chiron in Pisces, while old lovers resurface under a Venus trine Neptune alignment in your 4th House. Financial contracts may need revisiting as Mercury opposes Jupiter in your 2nd House of income, demanding renegotiation. This Retrograde mirrors your North Node karmic direction, pulling you toward growth. Chiron's wounded healer energy asks you to heal what was broken in past connections. Pause and review all agreements before signing. Comment your Sun sign below.
